title: Vasconcelos’ Team Clarifies That Ambassador Was Not Present During Netanyahu’s Speech
author: José Shaddai Olvera Torres
content:
_This article by José Shaddai Olvera Torres originally appeared in
the[September 28, 2026 edition of El
Chamuco](https://elchamuco.com.mx/2026/09/28/hector-vasconcelos-netanyahu-
onu/), Mexico's premier left wing daily newspaper._

**(September 28, 2026).—The Mexican mission to the UN specified that Héctor
Vasconcelos was not in the hall during the Israeli prime minister 's address.
The message does not clarify whether other members of the delegation took part
in the walkout.**

The team of **Héctor Vasconcelos** , Mexico's permanent representative to the
United Nations, clarified that the ambassador was not present in the General
Assembly hall during the speech by Israeli Prime Minister **Benjamin
Netanyahu** this past September 24.

The clarification was released through the diplomat's X account, after
questions and insults circulated regarding Mexico's absence from some lists
shared on social media of the delegations that left the chamber during
Netanyahu's address.

> We wish to report that Ambassador Héctor Vasconcelos was never present in
> the General Assembly hall during Mr. Netanyahu's address. With more
> information, you could have spared yourselves the insults.
>
> Héctor Vasconcelos' team

> A quienes se han interesado en el tema, deseamos informar que el embajador
> Héctor Vasconcelos nunca estuvo presente en la sala de la Asamblea General
> durante la alocución del Sr. Netanyahu. Con mayor información, hubieran
> podido ahorrarse los insultos.  
>  
> Les recordamos que el…
>
> -- Héctor Vasconcelos (@HVasconcelos_) [September 27,
> 2026](https://x.com/HVasconcelos_/status/2104306117991952705?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw)

### What Happened During Netanyahu's Speech?

When Netanyahu began his address to the General Assembly, **dozens of
diplomatic representatives left the hall** in a protest action related to the
situation in Gaza. **The Israeli prime minister referred to those who left the
chamber as “cowards.”**

Subsequently, different lists of countries that had supposedly taken part in
the walkout circulated on social media. **Mexico did not appear on some of
those lists** , which raised questions about the position of its mission.

However, a country's absence from a list shared on social media **does not by
itself establish that its delegation remained in the chamber**. Nor is there,
so far, an official United Nations record that would make it possible to
confirm exhaustively which delegations took part in the walkout.

### Vasconcelos Was Not in the Hall

The clarification from the ambassador's team is limited to establishing that
**Héctor Vasconcelos was not present during Netanyahu 's speech**.

The message does not specify where the permanent representative was at that
moment, nor does it state whether other members of the Mexican diplomatic
mission remained in the hall or took part in the collective walkout.

Therefore, the clarification makes it possible to rule out the claim that
Vasconcelos had remained in his seat during Netanyahu's address, but **does
not by itself allow a conclusion about the conduct of the entire Mexican
delegation**.

The clarification coincides with information published by other media outlets
after doubts arose on social media about the ambassador's presence.

### Vasconcelos' Team Considers the Exchange Closed

In the same post, the diplomat's team noted that Vasconcelos does not
personally answer the messages he receives through that social network due to
his activities and lack of time.

After clarifying his absence from the chamber, the team considered the
exchange on the subject concluded.

The controversy arose in the context of the international criticism
surrounding Netanyahu's speech and the exit of dozens of delegations from the
General Assembly. The Mexican clarification, however, refers specifically to
the presence of its permanent representative and **does not constitute
confirmation regarding the participation of the entire Mexican mission in the
walkout**.
